notes: Dynamics pass on the v2 kickback deck (2026-10-07). Two briefs from Jerome: 'zero dynamics in it, be 500% more creative' and 'where is the circle I asked for'. PART 1: the rectangular four-step flow on physical 20 was replaced with a real circular cycle - an unfilled oval track (open centre), four step boxes sitting on the ring at the cardinal points, four chevrons between the boxes showing clockwise direction, and the centre caption added after the ring so it sits above it. It renders as a ring with an open centre. Physical 16 kept its tolerance-band bars deliberately: the ring belongs on the follow-up slide, and 16 already carries a working band graphic. PART 2: native PowerPoint charts added on physical 9 (ISZE billing against Portugal sales to dealer as a two-line euro chart, family build as a euro column chart, plus an oversized brake-part callout), 12 and 13 (ITUK monthly billing as a column chart with the EUR 515,524 run rate as a dashed reference line, February EUR 861,719 and the 13 March 2026 price change marked and annotated). Slides 12 and 13 had no free space, so their duplicate value tables were removed and every one of their figures re-printed as chart annotations. Slide 8 gained euro data bars in the billed column; slide 21 already carried a chevron chain into the tension block and was left alone rather than padded. EURO ONLY throughout: no unit axis, no share, no growth rate on pieces. Verified figures and caveats unchanged: EUR 393,000 across eleven customers, 7 of 9 at or above plan, the 9.0% ramp and Kosha path, ITUK February EUR 346,195, IBX 32->63 days into the 60-75 band, ISD dark since January 2025 with the 2 October 2026 submission indicative, EUR 225,744 headline and EUR 225,364 family total kept separately sourced. A .pptx is not interactive; 'dynamic' here means the slides look alive, not that they animate. A unit bug in the chevron helper (inches added to EMU) made the file unopenable mid-run; it was found by bisecting the shapes, fixed, and the file now opens.
